transport_diagnostics.timing_scope: Receive-call duration includes OS wait and scheduling; it does not isolate radio latency. No packet bodies or credentials recorded.

collector_sleep.scope: Existing sleep calls only; overshoot includes scheduler and execution overhead, not a proved cause.

reply_provenance.scope: Host elapsed time from original send completion, including OS/radio waits. Board and host intervals are unsynchronised. Eviction/untracked reply does not prove loss. No nonce, input bytes, address or packet payload exported.
